# MacroUI native pipe vectors. Version 1.
# A # line is a comment. A blank line is ignored.
# A record is 'name direction' then one line of uppercase hex bytes.
# direction: engine, shell, json, reject.
# engine and shell are frames. json is the AHK hello (first byte 7B).
# reject is a pipe message a decoder must not accept.
# Layout: docs/engine/ipc-protocol.md

# armed 0
hello-disarmed engine
4D 55 49 31 01 00 01 00 01 00 00 00 00

# armed 1
hello-armed engine
4D 55 49 31 01 00 01 00 01 00 00 00 01

# armed, default, Game.exe, sprint-jump / Sprint jump, held space, window Game.exe / Game
state-sample engine
4D 55 49 31 01 00 02 00 4C 00 00 00 01 00 01 00 01 00 01 00 07 00 64 65 66 61 75 6C 74 08 00 47 61 6D 65 2E 65 78 65 0B 00 73 70 72 69 6E 74 2D 6A 75 6D 70 0B 00 53 70 72 69 6E 74 20 6A 75 6D 70 05 00 73 70 61 63 65 08 00 47 61 6D 65 2E 65 78 65 04 00 47 61 6D 65

# command ok, no id
ack-command engine
4D 55 49 31 01 00 03 00 04 00 00 00 01 01 00 00

# profile ok, no id
ack-profile engine
4D 55 49 31 01 00 03 00 04 00 00 00 01 02 00 00

# malformed frame
ack-bad-frame engine
4D 55 49 31 01 00 03 00 0D 00 00 00 00 00 09 00 62 61 64 20 66 72 61 6D 65

# version other than 1
ack-bad-version engine
4D 55 49 31 01 00 03 00 0F 00 00 00 00 00 0B 00 62 61 64 20 76 65 72 73 69 6F 6E

# where engine, code profile-read
error-profile-read engine
4D 55 49 31 01 00 04 00 27 00 00 00 01 01 23 00 74 68 65 20 73 61 76 65 64 20 70 72 6F 66 69 6C 65 20 63 6F 75 6C 64 20 6E 6F 74 20 62 65 20 72 65 61 64

# AHK hello. First byte 7B. Trailing newline from SendRaw
json-hello json
